title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
key_concepts: Why RAG beats naive context stuffing
expected_skills: Choose appropriate chunking strategies for different document types
Implement MMR to reduce redundant retrieved chunks
Evaluate RAG quality using RAGAS metrics
sample_questions: Explain the end-to-end flow of a RAG pipeline from document ingestion to answer generation.
What chunking strategy would you use for a 200-page PDF and why?
What is MMR retrieval and how does it differ from pure similarity search?
How would you evaluate the quality of a RAG system? What metrics would you use?
